faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BRIC NIAB Project Technical Support – III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Technical Support – III position at BRIC NIAB is 04 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a three-year graduate degree in Biological Sciences/Biotechnology with three years of experience, or a postgraduate degree in Biological Sciences/Biotechnology, or a four-year graduate degree in Engineering (Biotechnology).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support – III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support – III post is 35 years. Age relaxation details are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA, if applicable.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support – III?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support – III position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BRIC NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BRIC NIAB Project Technical Support – III?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a screening of applications followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.answer: Yes, the job is on a contractual basis. This is a common practice for project-based roles in research institutions.
